references.text: Chemosh is mentioned as the god of the Moabites, whom Israel defeated
Refers to Chemosh as the god of Moab who was worshiped by Solomon
Chemosh is called the abomination of the Moabites, and his high place was destroyed by Josiah
The prophecy against Moab mentions Chemosh going into captivity
Moab will be put to shame over Chemosh, just as Israel was put to shame over Bethel
Refers to Chemosh's people and their fate
The Lord gave the Moabites their land as an inheritance, parallel to the idea that gods give land to their people
The Lord gave the Ammonites their land as an inheritance, relevant to the context with Jephthah and the Ammonites
